title: Shapes and Norms of Random Pairs
summary: The shape function of a pair of finite-valued random variables was introduced in arXiv:2606.23849, where it was used to derive a spectral bound on the entanglement of the pair, a quantity measuring the extent to which their mutual information can be extracted. In this article, we further develop the theory of shape functions for pairs of random variables.
